simple.meaning: Jaala or Jaalah , one of the Nethinim

simple.summary: יַעֲלָא (Yaʻălâʼ) means Jaala or Jaalah , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 56.

definitions.short: Jaala or Jaalah , one of the Nethinim
definitions.full: H3279. Yaala or Yaalah II. יַעֲלָה יַעֲלָא, proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles , יַעֲלָא Neh 7:58 = יַעֲלָה Ezra 2:56 . יַעְלָם see below עלם .
